title: GonogoFacts
description: The flight's facts the Go / No-Go is put together from (gonogo_input; gonogo_brief's `facts`): the briefing's, the nav log's, the loading's and the route's own figures (gonogo_route_figures).

failed.description: Why the briefing could not be had, in a line; null where it did not fail.

weather_unavailable.description: The briefing's sources that did not answer (its `weather_unavailable`); empty with no briefing.

forecast.description: The briefing's worst forecast along the route, and the stations whose forecast ceiling has no height; null with no briefing.

ceiling_unknown_at.description: The TAF stations along the route whose forecast has a broken or overcast layer with no height as its lowest.

vfr_not_recommended.description: The briefing's reasons for AIM 7-1-5's "VFR flight not recommended"; dropped under IFR.

under_minimums.description: Where the weather is under the pilot's own minimums (minimums).

icing.description: The icing finding's lines, in order: one line of them, joined.

icing_unchecked.description: Under IFR, the forecast icing could not be had.

landings.description: Every field the flight lands at, each once: whose current report's ceiling with no height is said unchecked (14 CFR 91.103).

metars.description: The briefing's METARs by ident (each null where none came); a report's `ceiling_unknown` (a broken or overcast layer with no height as its lowest, "OVC///") is read.

hazards.description: The SIGMETs and G-AIRMETs along the route, by name.

terminal_alerts.description: The ITWS alerts in force now at the route's airports, in words.

flow_programs.description: The Command Center's programs at the route's airports, in words.

route_figures.description: gonogo_route_figures' answer: the fuel's and the TFRs'.

special_use.description: The special-use areas the legs cross, each with when it is in use at the pass.

nav.description: The nav log's altitude answer: its `flown`, `altitude_ft`, `options` (each `kind` and `steps`' `altitude_ft`) and `cautions` (each `reasons`); null while it is awaited.

problem.description: No VFR altitude fits, in a line.

legs_ft.description: Each leg's altitude, feet MSL: the highest is the oxygen finding's (14 CFR 91.211); with none, the plan picked's highest step (`nav`).

totals.description: The nav log's totals are in.

aircraft.description: The airplane's profile: its takeoff and landing tables for the runways, its supplemental_oxygen and pressurized for the oxygen finding (14 CFR 91.211(a), (b)).

runway_checks.description: The runway checks, each with its field's `ident` (gonogo_runway_findings' `checks`).

loading.description: The airplane has a POH loading.

loaded.description: gonogo_balance's answer with the pilot's own load; null with no load.
